contract_before: Let S=entry SP, F=S-18. Save input mode at F+0, initialize output word and local result F+16 to zero; save current pointer at F+14 after +23C3. Clear bit7 of record byte[p+3] and snapshot bytes[p+2], masked[p+3], [p+5] at F+9/+10/+11. Mode bit0 gates copy/repair path. +1A8C(length) drains the staged tail via +1A47, sets working_record_pointer[69C5] to post-copy staging_cursor[69C3], clears extent_count[69C7], then adds/checks the initial extent via +1A14. The caller copies record length bytes to this working base. OBSERVED +247C returns A=00/CY=1; CMA/RAR tests returned A bit0, giving CY=1 and +2601 JNC fallthrough to the word patch. DEDUCED: the patch selects a clear A bit0; the helper meaning remains opaque. +240B(k) on guard-false returns FF/CY=1 exactly when record[p+3]&7 equals k; this selects child/field branches, not an ordering test. +23DF(0) advances tested_pointer by length bytes until the advanced tag&E0 equals zero or the bound/tag guard stops it. Dispatch local tag 41/40 through recursive +24BC calls (C=mode&1 or 4). OBSERVED at +2798: guard A=00 OR field-7 A=FF gives FF on all ten paths; CMA gives 00, RAR gives CY=0 and JNC selects the mode&1 child. DEDUCED: that branch tests the original combined Boolean as true, not false. F+3 saves tested_pointer before this first tag-41 child; F+5 saves tested_pointer after it returns. Restoring F+3 causes the observed C05/C06 mode4 child to revisit the same pointer. F+11 counts decrement-path iterations, not total recursive children: C05 starts at 2 with four children, C06 at 1 with three. After the count loop, +1A35 computes current tested_pointer minus F+5; borrow selects F+5, implementing unsigned max(current tested_pointer,F+5). The later +1A33 computes F+7 minus tested_pointer; its borrow arm would assign F+7 as an upper clamp (STATIC / UNOBSERVED, RAW bytes retained). Publish F+16 to output_record_word[6A8E]; this is distinct from restoring F+12 and publishing opaque +2290 returned HL through result_slot_pointer[6A88]. Epilogue SP=F+18 restores original hardware return slot. Opaque calls and unprocessed arms prevent a full behavioral contract.
